Ford Mustang Car Wrap

This Ford Mustang Car Wrap was done for one of the Vinyl Wrap Toronto Staff members. He was looking to update the atheistic of the car from the standard paint job when he bought the car to a more distinctive appearance with graphics.

The staff member worked with our in-house design team to explore different colours, textures, and details. The graphics artist worked to create a look that the owner was proud to have on his muscle car. Our installation crew then worked with the owner to ensure his desired vision was achieved. The staff member was excited to show off his car and drive it home after the job was completed.

Do you have an idea of how you would like your vehicle to brand and or style yourself? Speak to us about your inspiration and let us show you a few options that will meet your expectations?
We love Muscle car wraps like this Ford Mustang Car Wrap. They are some of our favourite vehicles to deal with and customers always have great ideas and visions.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto can wrap almost anything you can think of. Take a look at our Full Van Wraps for more ideas. We use Avery Dennison and 3M quality vinyl for all our wraps and decals. It does not matter which vehicle or colour it is currently we can wrap the whole vehicle or do a partial wrap. Let us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto help you stand out from the other car enthusiast.
